metadata.title: Customer Payment Receipts (Linked Receivables, Standalone Entry)

story.iWant: to record receipts and allocate them to invoices (including partials and advances)
story.soThat: AR balances and customer statements are correct
story.tasks:
**Backend Tasks:** - Create ARPayment entity and database migration (AC: #1-5, #10-11) - Entity fields: id, company_id, customer_id, receipt_number (auto-generated), receipt_date, cash/bank account, amount, payment method, status (DRAFT/POSTED/REVERSED), linked_voucher_id - Implement CompanyScopedEntity for multi-tenancy - Create ReceiptAllocation entity for invoice allocation tracking - Add Flyway migration V20251221__create_ar_payments.sql - Add validation annotations and constraints
- Receipt validation service (AC: #1-5) - ReceiptValidationService interface and implementation - Validate customer has open invoices - Validate allocations (no overpayment, within invoice remaining balance) - Validate standalone receipts (admin-only) - Return field-level error maps
- Receipt service (AC: #1-7, #10-11) - ReceiptService interface and ReceiptServiceImpl - CRUD operations: findAll (paginated, filtered), findById, create, update - allocateInvoices(receiptId, allocations) - supports single/multiple invoice allocation - postReceipt(receiptId) - generates voucher (Dr 111/112, Cr 131), updates invoice statuses - reverseReceipt(receiptId, reason) - generates linked reversal voucher - getOpenInvoicesForCustomer(customerId) - for customer picker - Integrate AuditService for all operations
- Receipt controller and API (AC: #1-5, #8-9) - ReceiptController with REST endpoints - GET /api/v1/ar/receipts (pagination, filters) - POST /api/v1/ar/receipts (create with validation) - POST /api/v1/ar/receipts/{id}/post (post receipt) - POST /api/v1/ar/receipts/{id}/reverse (reverse posted receipt) - POST /api/v1/ar/receipts/batch-import (Excel import) - RBAC enforcement: accountants create/post, chief accountant/CFO reverse
- Voucher engine integration (AC: #4-7, #10-11) - Generate voucher: Dr Bank/Cash (111/112), Cr AR (131) - Include all dimensions (customer, cost center, project) - Update invoice statuses (PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID) - Update invoice remaining_balance - Handle reversal voucher generation with cross-linking
- Receipt batch import service (AC: #8-9, #11) - ReceiptImportService interface and implementation - Parse Excel file with Apache POI - Atomic transaction (all succeed or all fail) - Return detailed error map with row numbers - Create audit log entry per imported row
**Frontend Tasks:** - Receipt form component (AC: #1-3, #5, #10-11) - ReceiptForm component following SalesInvoiceForm patterns - Customer picker filtering to customers with open invoices - Auto-generated receipt number (read-only) - Cash/bank account picker with balance display - Payment method dropdown (CASH, BANK_TRANSFER, CHECK, OTHER) - Standalone receipt toggle (admin-only, with warning) - Real-time validation - Draft autosave (30s)
- Receipt allocation UI (AC: #2) - ReceiptAllocationGrid component following VoucherLineGrid patterns - Display open invoices for selected customer - Allow partial allocations to individual invoices - Real-time validation (prevent overpayment) - Allocation summary display
- Receipt list component (AC: #1-5, #10) - ReceiptList component following SalesInvoiceList patterns - DataTablePro with pagination, sorting, filtering - Status badges (DRAFT, POSTED, REVERSED) - Standalone receipt indicator - Actions: view, edit, delete, post, reverse
- Receipt reversal dialog (AC: #6-7) - ReceiptReversalDialog component - Show receipt details and allocations - Required reversal reason field - Confirm action with warning
**Testing:** - Unit tests for ReceiptService (allocation, validation, posting) - Unit tests for ReceiptValidationService - Integration tests for receipt API endpoints - Integration tests for voucher posting integration - Component tests for receipt form and list - E2E tests for complete receipt flow

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. (AC23-001) Receipt form has customer picker that filters to customers with open invoices; date/number auto-generated (per customer/period); cash/bank account; amount; reference; attachment; and payment method (CASH, BANK_TRANSFER, CHECK, OTHER).
2. (AC23-002) Allocation UI allows selection of one or many invoices; supports partial and prorated allocations; prevents overpayments; shows remaining amount per invoice.
3. (AC23-003) Standalone receipts (advances/on-account) allowed; can later be matched to invoices; are flagged in audit.
4. (AC23-004) Posting entry generates GL voucher: Dr Bank/Cash (account 111 or 112), Cr AR (account 131).
5. (AC23-005) Posting entry includes all configured dimensions (customer, cost center, project if present) in GL lines.
6. (AC23-006) Reversal path: generates linked reversal voucher with both vouchers cross-linked in audit trail.
7. (AC23-007) Reversal requires mandatory reversal reason; reason is logged in voucher audit.
8. (AC23-008) Import receipts: atomic batch (all succeed or all fail); template-based with required column mapping.
9. (AC23-009) Import error handling: returns detailed error map with row numbers and validation failure reasons.
10. (AC23-010) Full audit on create/edit/post: tracks user, timestamp, and old/new values in audit log.
11. (AC23-011) Reversal and import: audit logged with full before/after state; allocation changes include invoice balance deltas.

artifact.title: Epic 5: Accounts Receivable (AR) Module
artifact.snippet: Receipt form with customer picker, date/number auto-generation, allocation UI supporting single/multi invoice allocations with partial payments, standalone receipts for advances, posting with voucher generation (Dr Bank/Cash, Cr AR), reversal with cross-linking, import with atomic batch processing, and comprehensive audit trail.

artifact.title: Epic Technical Specification: Sales Invoice Entry & AR Management
artifact.snippet: Complete technical specification for AR receipts including data models (ARReceipt, ARAllocation), API contracts (POST /api/v1/ar-receipts, allocation endpoints), validation rules (allocation sums, remaining balance checks), voucher integration patterns, and audit requirements. Covers FIFO/manual allocation, reversal voucher cross-linking, and import validation.

artifact.title: Data Architecture
artifact.snippet: Row-level filtering via company_id on all tables. Spring Data JPA filter at repository level, API-level enforcement via security filter, Supabase RLS policies as additional layer. All AR entities inherit CompanyScopedEntity.

artifact.title: Security Architecture
artifact.snippet: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Admin, Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO. Spring Security method-level security, API-level permission checks, company-level data isolation. Accountants create/post receipts; Chief Accountant/CFO reverse receipts; standalone receipts require admin role.

artifact.title: Story 5.2: Invoice Approval Workflow (Maker-Checker)
artifact.snippet: AR approval infrastructure (SalesInvoiceApprovalService) implemented with threshold-based approval and maker-checker patterns. Integration tests pass, but 13 unit tests have mock/behavior mismatches. Receipt posting may need approval workflow integration for high-value transactions.

artifact.title: Story 4.3: Cash Payments (Linked to Bills, Standalone)
artifact.snippet: Payment allocation patterns established: FIFO support with manual override, multiple bill allocation, overpayment prevention, allocation order tracking. Reversal voucher generation with cross-linking. PaymentValidationService pattern for overpayment prevention and standalone transaction flagging.

artifact.reason: Reference pattern for AR receipt entity structure. Shows CompanyScopedEntity implementation, payment status enum, cash/bank account relationships, standalone flag, linked voucher ID, and audit timestamps. AR receipts (ARPayment) should follow identical structure with customer_id instead of supplier_id.

Reference pattern for receipt allocation entity. Shows allocation tracking with allocated_amount, allocation_order, and company_id scoping. ReceiptAllocation should follow same pattern with sales_invoice_id instead of purchase_bill_id.

Target entity for receipt allocation. Shows invoice structure with customer_id, status enum (DRAFT/POSTED/PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID), total_amount, vat_amount, and posted_voucher_id. Receipts need to update invoice status and track allocated amounts against these invoices.

Reference implementation for payment service patterns. Shows CRUD operations, allocation logic, voucher posting integration, validation service calls, and audit logging. ReceiptServiceImpl should follow identical patterns for AR domain.

Reference pattern for validation service interface. Shows validation methods for allocations, account balance, standalone payments, and payment proof. ReceiptValidationService should implement parallel methods for AR domain.

Reference pattern for receipt form implementation. Shows supplier/customer picker, cash/bank account selection, allocation grid integration, standalone toggle, real-time validation, and draft autosave. ReceiptForm should follow identical patterns with customer domain.

Reference pattern for receipt allocation UI. Shows grid display of open bills/invoices, allocation amount inputs, remaining balance tracking, and real-time validation. ReceiptAllocationGrid should mirror this for sales invoices.
Required interface for all AR entities. Ensures company_id filtering at repository level for multi-tenancy. ARPayment and ReceiptAllocation must implement this interface.

story-context.constraints:
**Multi-Tenancy:** - All AR receipt operations must respect company_id scoping - ARPayment and ReceiptAllocation entities must implement CompanyScopedEntity - All repository queries and JPA filters must include company_id filtering - API endpoints must enforce company context via CompanyContext.getCompanyId()
**Allocation Design:** - Support flexible allocation: single invoice, multiple invoices, partial allocations - Prevent overpayment: sum(allocations) must not exceed receipt amount - Prevent over-allocation: per-invoice allocation must not exceed invoice remaining_balance - Enforce at database level with CHECK constraints and application validation - Track allocation order for audit trail
**Standalone Receipts:** - Support advance payments/on-account receipts (no immediate invoice allocation) - Flag with is_standalone=true - Allow later matching to invoices (partial or full allocation) - Admin-only for MVP (RBAC enforcement required) - Audit flag for all standalone receipts
**Voucher Engine Integration:** - Receipts post through Epic 3 voucher engine - Generate journal entry: Dr Bank/Cash (111/112), Cr AR (131) - Include all dimensions: customer (131), cost center (if configured), project (if present) - Link receipt to voucher via linked_voucher_id - Update invoice statuses (PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID) based on allocation - Update invoice remaining_balance after allocation - Handle voucher posting failures with transaction rollback
**Reversal Pattern:** - Generate linked reversal voucher on receipt reversal - Maintain cross-references: original ← → reversal - Require mandatory reversal reason (logged in voucher audit) - Follow same pattern as AP payment reversals (Story 4.3) - Revert invoice statuses and remaining_balance - Mark allocations as reversed (do not delete)
**RBAC and Permissions:** - Accountants: create, edit (DRAFT), post receipts - Chief Accountant: all accountant permissions + reverse posted receipts - CFO: view-only (no create/edit/post) - Admin: all permissions + standalone receipts - Enforce via Spring Security @PreAuthorize on service methods - API-level permission checks in controllers
**Project Structure:** - Backend entities: backend/src/main/java/com/accounting/entity/ - Backend services: backend/src/main/java/com/accounting/service/impl/sales/ - Backend controllers: backend/src/main/java/com/accounting/controller/sales/ - Flyway migrations: backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/ - Frontend pages: frontend/src/features/accounting/pages/Receipts/ - Frontend components: frontend/src/components/receipt/ - Follow AR pattern (under /sales) not AP pattern (under /payment)
**Audit Requirements:** - Use existing AuditService for all receipt operations - Log create/edit/allocate/post/reverse/import actions - Include before/after snapshots (JSON) - Track actor, timestamp, device IP, user agent - Compute event hash (SHA256) for integrity - Log allocation changes with invoice balance deltas
**Coding Standards:** - Backend: Use Spotless formatter (mvn spotless:apply) - Backend: All validation via Jakarta Bean Validation annotations - Backend: Use BigDecimal with SCALE=2, ROUNDING_MODE=HALF_UP for money - Frontend: Use ESLint/Prettier - Frontend: Import via path aliases (@/features/..., @/components/...) - UI: Use shadcn/ui components consistently - Tables: Must have search, refresh, count, pagination (DataTablePro pattern)
story-context.interfaces:
**REST API Endpoints:**
GET /api/v1/ar/receipts - Query params: page, size, sort, customer, status, dateFrom, dateTo, search, standalone - Response: { data: { content: [ARReceipt], totalElements, totalPages }, meta: {...} } - Authorization: All authenticated users
GET /api/v1/ar/receipts/{id} - Response: Full receipt with allocations, customer details - Authorization: All authenticated users (company-scoped)
POST /api/v1/ar/receipts - Request: { customerId, receiptDate, cashAccountId OR bankAccountId, amount, payee, reference, paymentMethod, isStandalone, allocations: [{ invoiceId, allocatedAmount }] } - Response: { data: { id, receiptNumber, status: 'DRAFT' }, meta: {...} } - Validation: customer exists, date in open period, account exists, amount > 0, allocations sum ≤ amount - Authorization: Accountant role required
PUT /api/v1/ar/receipts/{id} - Request: { amount, reference, allocations: [...] } - Validation: status must be DRAFT - Authorization: Accountant role, must be creator or admin
DELETE /api/v1/ar/receipts/{id} - Validation: status must be DRAFT - Authorization: Accountant role, must be creator or admin
POST /api/v1/ar/receipts/{id}/allocate - Request: { allocations: [{ invoiceId, allocatedAmount }] } - Response: { data: { updatedReceipt, allocations }, meta: {...} } - Validation: allocations sum ≤ receipt amount, per-invoice allocation ≤ remaining balance - Authorization: Accountant role
POST /api/v1/ar/receipts/{id}/post - Request: {} (trigger posting) - Response: { data: { status: 'POSTED', voucherId, updatedInvoices }, meta: {...} } - Side effects: create voucher, update invoice statuses, invalidate AR aging cache - Authorization: Accountant role
POST /api/v1/ar/receipts/{id}/reverse - Request: { reversalReason } - Response: { data: { reversalReceiptId, reversalVoucherId }, meta: {...} } - Side effects: create reversal receipt, create reversal voucher, revert invoice statuses - Authorization: Chief Accountant or CFO role
GET /api/v1/ar/receipts/open-invoices/{customerId} - Response: { data: { invoices: [{ id, invoiceNumber, date, totalAmount, remainingBalance }] }, meta: {...} } - Authorization: All authenticated users
POST /api/v1/ar/receipts/batch-import - Content-Type: multipart/form-data - Request: FormData with Excel file - Response: { data: { importedCount, errorCount, errorMap: [{ rowNumber, field, message }] }, meta: {...} } - Validation: atomic batch (all succeed or all fail) - Authorization: Accountant role
**Service Interfaces:**
ReceiptService: - Page<ARPaymentListDTO> findAll(Pageable, filters) - Optional<ARPaymentDTO> findById(UUID) - ARPaymentDTO create(ARPaymentCreateRequest) - ARPaymentDTO update(UUID, ARPaymentUpdateRequest) - void delete(UUID) - ARPaymentDTO allocateInvoices(UUID receiptId, List<AllocationRequest>) - ARPaymentDTO postReceipt(UUID receiptId) - ARPaymentDTO reverseReceipt(UUID receiptId, String reason) - List<SalesInvoiceDTO> getOpenInvoicesForCustomer(Long customerId)
ReceiptValidationService: - PaymentValidationResult validateCustomerHasOpenInvoices(Long customerId) - PaymentValidationResult validateAllocations(List<AllocationRequest>, BigDecimal receiptAmount) - PaymentValidationResult validateAccountBalance(Long accountId, BigDecimal amount) - PaymentValidationResult validateStandaloneReceipt(ARPayment receipt) - PaymentValidationResult validateReceiptProof(BigDecimal amount, String proofUrl)
ReceiptImportService: - ImportResult importReceipts(MultipartFile file) - byte[] generateTemplate()

tests.standards:
**Backend Testing:** - JUnit 5 with Spring Boot Test framework - MockMvc for integration tests - Testcontainers for PostgreSQL integration tests - Target: 80% code coverage minimum - Unit tests: isolated service logic with mocked dependencies - Integration tests: full Spring context with database
**Frontend Testing:** - Vitest with React Testing Library - Component tests: user interactions and state management - Integration tests: API mocking with MSW - E2E tests: Playwright for critical paths - Target: 70% code coverage minimum
**Test Naming:** - Backend: test_{methodName}_{scenario}_{expectedOutcome} - Frontend: {ComponentName}.test.tsx with describe/it blocks
**Patterns:** - Follow existing test patterns from PaymentServiceImplTest - Follow existing component test patterns from PaymentForm.test.tsx - Use test factories for entity creation (e.g., TestDataFactory) - Use @Transactional for database cleanup in integration tests
tests.locations:
**Backend:** - Unit tests: backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/service/impl/sales/ - Integration tests: backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/controller/sales/ - Entity tests: backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/entity/
**Frontend:** - Component tests: frontend/src/features/accounting/pages/Receipts/__tests__/ - Component tests: frontend/src/components/receipt/__tests__/ - E2E tests: tests/e2e/ar-receipt-workflow.spec.ts - API tests: tests/api/ar-receipt-api.spec.ts
tests.ideas:
**AC23-001 (Receipt Form Fields):** - Test customer picker filters to customers with open invoices - Test auto-generated receipt number (unique per company/year) - Test cash/bank account selection (mutually exclusive) - Test payment method dropdown (all enum values) - Test form validation (required fields)
**AC23-002 (Allocation UI):** - Test single invoice allocation (full payment) - Test multiple invoice allocation (partial payments) - Test allocation sum validation (cannot exceed receipt amount) - Test per-invoice allocation validation (cannot exceed remaining balance) - Test allocation preview/summary display
**AC23-003 (Standalone Receipts):** - Test standalone receipt creation (admin-only) - Test standalone receipt flag in audit - Test later matching to invoices - Test RBAC rejection for non-admin users
**AC23-004 (Voucher Posting):** - Test voucher generation with Dr Bank/Cash (111/112), Cr AR (131) - Test voucher line amounts match receipt amount - Test voucher creation fails on invalid account
**AC23-005 (Dimension Inclusion):** - Test voucher includes customer dimension (131) - Test voucher includes cost center (if configured) - Test voucher includes project (if present)
**AC23-006 (Reversal Cross-linking):** - Test reversal receipt creation - Test reversal voucher generation - Test cross-references (original ← → reversal) - Test audit trail includes cross-references
**AC23-007 (Reversal Reason):** - Test reversal requires reason (validation) - Test reversal reason logged in voucher audit - Test reversal reason visible in UI
**AC23-008 (Import Atomic Batch):** - Test all rows succeed (happy path) - Test all rows fail if one row has error - Test template validation (required columns) - Test row count limit (1000 rows)
**AC23-009 (Import Error Handling):** - Test error map includes row numbers - Test error map includes field names - Test error map includes validation messages - Test downloadable error report
**AC23-010 (Create/Edit/Post Audit):** - Test audit log entry on create - Test audit log entry on edit (with before/after) - Test audit log entry on post - Test audit includes user, timestamp, device IP
**AC23-011 (Reversal/Import Audit):** - Test reversal audit includes full before/after state - Test import audit includes batch summary - Test allocation audit includes invoice balance deltas
**Integration Tests:** - Test complete receipt flow: create → allocate → post → reverse - Test receipt posting updates invoice statuses correctly - Test receipt reversal reverts invoice statuses correctly - Test period closure prevents posting to closed period - Test company scoping (cannot access other company receipts)
**E2E Tests:** - Test accountant creates receipt and allocates to invoices - Test chief accountant reverses posted receipt - Test import receipts from Excel file - Test standalone receipt creation and later matching
